Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the time. Quick recap and a simple checklist so we can get your trial environment up and producing useful signals quickly. High-level notes from discovery:

- Primary use case: customer support summarization + 1-shot retrieval for KB articles (English-first, ~10k tickets/mo).
- Success metric: 90% reduction in average handling time on triage templates + stable latency < 250ms 95th.
- Tech constraints: must run in us-west region; data residency handled by our VPC option (later phase).
- Stakeholders: Jordan (product), Priya (IT/procurement), and SRE to validate network.

Proposed immediate steps (mutual action plan):
1) I drop the trial sandbox + setup checklist (attached).
2) You provision a test dataset (anonymized) and share S3 location or allow upload.
3) We run a guided kickoff with CS to validate keys and sample queries (15–30 min).

Attachments: trial-setup-checklist.pdf (contains walk-through + minimal data sample schema).

Can you confirm which day works for a 20-minute guided kickoff next week? I can do Tue/Wed morning PST or Thu afternoon PST. If procurement is a blocker, tell me — we can run a demo-only sandbox while that completes.

Cheers,
